QUOTE: When a channel is archived over the websocket and the setting is off, the app kicks the user out if that channel is current (`handleKickFromChannel` with `CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`) and removes the user's membership. When on, the membership is kept.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer covers removal and kick-out when not viewable, but it only says membership is "kept" when viewable. It never says the channel is marked deleted (delete_at set) in the websocket case, and the local archiveChannel row doesn't cover the websocket handler either.
